Annual Meetings

Afternoon Session - 2019 Meeting

Buffett has a "feeling" the U.K. vote for Brexit was a mistake, but it doesn't dampen his enthusiasm to do a deal there. He also says Berkshire is strong on the environment but won't spend time and money compiling reports for activists, and predicts Elon Musk's plan for Tesla to sell auto insurance won't be successful. "I worry much more about Progressive" as a competitor for Berkshire's GEICO.

Sat, May 4 2019 • 1:00 PM EDT
Key Chapters —
  1. 2. Buffett: I'm lucky that I can "control my own time"
  2. 3. "We're not in the business of explaining why we own a stock"
  3. 9. Berkshire is strong on the environment but won't do expensive reports to prove it
  4. 12. Why Berkshire doesn't put its unspent cash into a stock index fund
  5. 15. Regulations can be "irritating," but they're needed for banks and insurance
  6. 18. Buffett has "feeling" Brexit vote was a mistake, but he's still anxious for a U.K. deal
  7. 25. Occidental came to us for a $10B loan because we could do it quickly
  8. 28. Buffett would bet against a car company like Tesla being able to compete on auto insurance
